en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own profile and get the same Germany-versus-Canada comparison before you apply anywhere
en.runTitle: Bengaluru to Germany or Canada: a 29-year-old backend engineer with INR 18 lakh

fields.label: Awarding university, degree and dates
fields.value: B.Tech in computer science from an AICTE-approved university

fields.label: Documented technical duties
fields.value: 6 years of full-time backend work (Java, Go, cloud)

fields.label: Language scores
fields.value: IELTS not taken yet (expects about 7.5 overall); no German

fields.label: Job offers
fields.placeholder: e.g. none yet, or one written offer from a Berlin company at EUR 60,000

fields.label: Search checkpoint and priorities
fields.value: A 30-day action list for each route

en.template: Compare an offer-first German Blue Card, Opportunity Card and Canadian Express Entry for {passport}, {family}, {degree}, {duties}, {language}, {offers} and {savings}. Separate eligibility from selection, check the applicable dated thresholds and post-reform draws, and model cash through first salary without double-counting capital. Give me {priorities}. Plan only; do not apply, create accounts, contact anyone, book or pay.

phases.title: Read the German and Canadian rules, costs and recent invitation rounds
phases.note: Blue Card, Opportunity Card, degree recognition, Express Entry rounds
phases.judgment: It noticed that Canada changed Express Entry on 3 November 2026: job-offer points are back, and a qualifying software offer can add 70, so older draw cut-offs predate the reform. The last General draw (April 2024, score 529) is shown as history, and processing times it could not confirm are left unconfirmed rather than guessed.

phases.title: Work out scores, take-home pay and cash needs, and double-check the Canadian points
phases.note: Points score step by step, fees, funds, living costs

phases.title: Write the comparison page and source list, then check desktop and phone layout
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed the points scores (360, 390, 429, 441), all six cash-through-first-salary estimates and the take-home figures, and found no defect. It also confirmed that Germany’s 2027 salary thresholds are shown as conditional on a proposed ceiling, not as confirmed rules.

workers: Read Canada’s official Express Entry rules, points criteria, fees and the actual invitation rounds
Read Germany’s official sources on the Blue Card, degree recognition, the Opportunity Card and settlement rules
Independently recomputed the points scores, cash models and take-home figures in the finished page

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的情况，申请之前先拿到同样的德国与加拿大对比
zh.runTitle: 从班加罗尔去德国还是加拿大：29 岁后端工程师，存款 18 拉克卢比

fields.label: 授予大学、学历和日期
fields.value: 印度 AICTE 认可大学的计算机科学工学学士（B.Tech）

fields.label: 语言成绩
fields.value: 还没考雅思（预计总分约 7.5）；不会德语

fields.label: 工作邀请
fields.placeholder: 例如：暂时没有，或有一份柏林公司的书面邀请，年薪 6 万欧元

fields.label: 求职检查点和优先事项
fields.value: 两条路线各自的 30 天行动清单

zh.template: 请为 {passport}、{family}、{degree}、{duties}、{language}、{offers} 和 {savings}，比较先拿工作的德国蓝卡、机会卡及加拿大快速通道。分清申请资格和筛选，核对适用年份门槛及改革后邀请，计算到首笔工资前的现金，避免重复计入本金。给出 {priorities}。只做规划，不申请、开户、联系他人、预订或付款。

phases.title: 阅读德国和加拿大的规则、费用和最近的邀请轮次
phases.note: 蓝卡、机会卡、学历认定、快速通道邀请轮次
phases.judgment: 发现加拿大在 2026 年 11 月 3 日改了快速通道规则：工作邀请加分恢复，符合条件的软件类邀请可加 70 分，所以改革前的历次分数线只能当历史参考。最近一次综合轮次（2024 年 4 月，分数线 529）只作为历史列出；查不到的办理时长就写“未确认”，没有猜。

phases.title: 算出积分、税后收入和现金需求，并复核加拿大积分
phases.note: 积分逐项计算、费用、资金证明、生活费

phases.title: 写成对比页面和来源清单，并检查电脑和手机版面
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事重算了积分（360、390、429、441）、六项“到首笔工资前”的现金估算和税后收入，没有发现问题；还确认德国 2027 年的薪资门槛是按一个拟议上限推算的，页面标为有条件、不是已确认的规则。

workers: 读了加拿大快速通道的官方规则、积分标准、费用，以及实际发出的邀请轮次
读了德国官方资料：蓝卡、学历认定、机会卡和定居规则
独立重算成品页面里的积分、现金测算和税后收入
